description: value of an element of the RTSP account book domain/live/stream-accounts (the copy at a member) and domain/live/stream-accounts/<member> (at the domain holder), V/03.6 Н1.3: an account {name, to, disabled, password_secret}; the password is only a keyring envelope (enc:v2, the sealing contract), there is no plain text in the book

name.description: the account name — the grammar of a domain person name (P/08.4 Н1.1 name), the key of the book (key: name)

to.description: "servers": all members of class server of the pass (V/03.6 Н1.3)

disabled.description: a disabled one does not play (V/03.6 Н1.1)

password_secret.description: the envelope enc:v2:<kid>:<nonce>:<ct> of the keyring of the holder (the member row) or of the member (the copy); only a secret reader opens it (V/03.6 Н1.1, the sealing contract)
